description: LiTrue manufactures custom lithium battery cells and packs across multiple chemistries, including LiFePO4, NMC, and LCO, serving B2B clients globally. The company's product range spans high-rate pouch and prismatic cells, including solid-state and semi-solid-state anode-free variants with energy densities up to 495Wh/kg, along with high C-rate NMC and LFP cells rated for continuous discharge up to 10C and pulse discharge up to 20C. Cells are rated for operation across a wide temperature range of -43°C to 55°C.
name: Lithium Battery Manufacturer
